senses.gloss:
(इर) कुपिर r. 4th cl. (कुप्यति)
To be angry, to be flushed with wrath.
With प्र,
to be very much enraged.
r. 10th cl. (कोपयति)
1 To shine: see कूप.
2 To speak.
(इ) कुपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (कुंपति कुंपयति)
1 To spread.
2 To remember.

r. 10th cl. (कूपयति)
1 To be weak.
2 To weaken: see कुप.

m. (-पः)
1 A well.
2 A hole, a hollow.
3 A mast.
4 A tree or rock in the midst of a river.
f. (-पी)
1 A small well.
2 The navel.
3 A flask, a bottle.
E.
कु to sound, (frogs croaking in a well, &c.) and प Uṇādi affix: the vowel is made long; also कूपक.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A slough, a heap of filth and mud.
E.
कु vile, पङ्क mud.

ind.
Excellently. Wrong reading for kūpat.^1
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260701. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/282.

n. (-थं)
1 A bad road.
2 Immorality, profligacy.
3 Heterodox doctrine.
E.
कु bad, and पथिन् a road; also कापथ.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Wicked, going in a bad or wrong road.
E.
कुपथ, and गामिन् who goes; also कुपथग, कुपथचर, &c.

mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं)
1 Relating to a bad road, literally or figuratively.
2 Counter-indicated, improper, unwholesome, (as regimen, &c.)
E.
कु and पथ्य proper, &c.

mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि)
Crooked-handed, having a deformed or maimed hand.
E.
कु bad, and पाणि the hand.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Incensed, angry, offended.
E.
कुप to be angry, क्त aff.

m. (-युः)
Flatulence or hypochondria.
E.
कुपित, and वायु wind.

m. (-कः)
Imminent or threatening death.
E.
कुपित, and अन्तक destroyer.

m. (-नी)
A fisherman.
E.
कुपिनी a net, and इनि aff.

f. (-नी)
A kind of net or snare, for catching small fish, made of bamboos or rushes.
E.
गुप to cover or conceal, इनि and ङीष् affixes; ग is changed to क.

m. (-न्दः)
A weaver.
E.
कुप or कुय to spread out, किन्दच् Uṇādi affix; also कुयिन्द.

m. (-लुः)
A sort of ebony tree.
E.
कु bad, पीलु a tree, so called.

m. (-त्रः)
1 A son of an inferior degree, as one adopted, &c.
2 A disobedient or wicked son.
E.
कु, and पुत्र a son.

m. (-षः)
1 A low or vile man.
2 A poltroon^1.
E.
कु bad, and पुरुष a man.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Inferior, low, vile.
E.
कु bad, and पूय to divide, अच् aff.

n. (-प्यं)
Base metal, copper, brass, &c. or any metal except gold and silver.
E.
गुप to conceal or preserve, क्यप् affix; ग is changed irregularly to क.

f. (-ला)
A braziery, a foundery, a place where metallic vessels, &c. are made or sold.
E.
कुप्य base metal, शाला a dwelling, a shop, &c.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Low, vile, last, worst.
E.
कु reverse, and प्रिय beloved; disagreeable.

m. (-वः)
A weak or frail raft or float.
E.
कु, and प्लव a raft.

m. (-कः)
1 The mast of a vessel.
2 A stake, &c. to which a boat is moored.
3 A leather oil vessel.
4 The hollow below the loins.
5 A funeral pile.
6 A well.
7 A temporary well, a hole dug for water in the dry bed of a rivulet.
8 A tree or rock in the middle of a stream.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-कः)
A frog in a well, applied to a person of no enterprise, one who never leaves his home.
E.
कूप, and मण्डूक a frog.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Horripilation, erection of the hairs of the body.
E.
कूप a well, and अङ्ग the body; some copies read कूपाङ्क, from अङ्क a mark.

m. (-रः)
The ocean; also कूवार, and अकूपार, &c.

f. (-का)
A stone or rock in the middle of a stream: see कूपक.
